publicNodeProcessModule: deferred; no module, global, process facts, or CLI/environment implementation is introduced

privateContract.validation: callable callback first; same execution realm; ordinary argument values retained by identity
privateContract.callbackReceiver: undefined before the callback's own strict/sloppy conversion
privateContract.callbackReturn: ignored; a returned rejecting Promise remains subject to the existing rejection tracker
privateContract.construction: not part of private contract; Node's public process.nextTick is constructible
privateContract.queue: FIFO, including callbacks appended by callbacks; no AsyncTask/pollable/clock adapter
privateContract.injection: single captured private callable passed directly to an audited classic-stream factory

limits.overflow: RangeError with own ERR_SM_NODE_SCHEDULER_LIMIT code; enqueue commits no partial entry; work-budget exhaustion fails the entire boundary rather than yielding
limits.promiseJobs: existing full SpiderMonkey checkpoint; these limits do not bound an independently infinite Promise chain

origins.classicEvaluation: ticks -> full Promise checkpoint -> ticks/full checkpoint until no ticks
origins.moduleEvaluation: full Promise checkpoint -> ticks/full checkpoint until no ticks
origins.deployedExport: ticks -> full Promise checkpoint -> ticks/full checkpoint until no ticks
origins.nativeTask: after the complete selected AsyncTask::run returns: ticks -> full Promise checkpoint -> repeat
origins.promiseJob: no nested checkpoint; the outer full checkpoint completes before any new ticks
origins.initializerScript: new explicit classic initializer checkpoint after successful JS_ExecuteScript and before content evaluation; separately validate private-realm access/semantics
origins.snapshotBinding: after all bindExports/export-getter execution: ticks/full checkpoint; reject leftovers/errors before snapshot
origins.finalizerBatch: preserve the existing batch, then ticks/full checkpoint; precise Node finalizer parity unverified

failurePolicy.tickThrow: preserve original pending thrown value; stop; release remaining tick roots; return false to existing fatal embedding path
failurePolicy.noExceptionFailure: return false to existing fatal embedding path; never convert to apparent success
failurePolicy.reentry: ERR_SM_NODE_SCHEDULER_REENTRY; no nested event loop/checkpoint or reset during callback execution
failurePolicy.eventErrors: check existing take_pending_event_exception after callbacks and full checkpoints
failurePolicy.promiseErrors: retain current SpiderMonkey job reporting and strict unhandled-rejection boundary; no new uncaughtException/unhandledRejection events

lifecycle.installation: EventLoop::init before builtin/application installation, optional flag only
lifecycle.snapshot: drain at actual evaluation and final post-bindExports boundary; require tick FIFO empty; EngineState::Initialized alone is insufficient
lifecycle.entry: require empty inactive FIFO before fresh deployed entry; no permanent entropy flag used as request/context identity
lifecycle.reuse: no tick entry crosses a completed export; module/callback objects may remain application state
lifecycle.reset: only outside callbacks; clear tick roots and storage; existing Engine::reset does not clear the separate Promise job queue
lifecycle.finalization: existing 16-round FinalizationRegistry policy unchanged and explicitly separate

futureAls.tickCapture: fallible new_resource(cx,current_token,true) once at enqueue, copying enabled bindings into a distinct mutable resource cell
futureAls.trace: new Heap<JSObject*> resource field in each Tick; trace it; root popped resource before clearing entry
futureAls.dispatch: resource-model-v3 Scope with rooted previous cell, actual callback realm, RAII restoration on every exit
futureAls.promise: separate reviewed JS::JobQueue/creation-metadata selection required; no then wrapping or context-bearing fake global
futureAls.nativeTask: capture once at actual registration and preserve on requeue; trace centrally and root active cell before removing queue entry
futureAls.entryOwner: fresh entry cell from explicit empty initialization template; request/handle owner and deliberate user AsyncResource lifetimes remain separate
blockedDecisions: void Engine::queue_async_task cannot propagate newly fallible capture without a reviewed API/caller change
